name: claude-remote-computer
description: Let Claude Code see your screen and use your computer. Drives GUI apps that have no API - shop-floor MES/ERP, JDeveloper and WinForms legacy tools, installers, Device Manager, PowerShell - and diagnoses PC problems by actually looking: error dialogs, Event Viewer, Task Manager. Remote servers over RDP work the same way. Pure ctypes + Pillow: no extension, no admin rights. A focus guard refuses to send input unless the target window is in front, so keystrokes never leak into the wrong app.
